name: Spinal Meningioma
definition: Usually benign intradural extramedullary tumor arising from arachnoid cap cells, commonly in the thoracic spine and capable of progressive cord compression.

investigations.principle: Contrast MRI is the principal diagnostic study.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Symptomatic compressive lesions are commonly treated surgically; observation is selective.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Modern structural diagnosis and decompression planning take priority.

patientEducation.summary: Usually benign intradural extramedullary tumor arising from arachnoid cap cells, commonly in the thoracic spine and capable of progressive cord compression.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
